job: Converge one approved Cloudflare HTTP(S) ingress to its exact plan and prove the resulting public route.
sideEffects: apply only the approved tunnel-route and proxied-DNS delta through the coordinator
stopConditions: the plan, approval, observed revision, or credential capability does not match
a requested effect is outside the approved ingress
a concurrent Cloudflare revision appears before mutation
the bounded DNS, route, TLS, or public HTTPS proof fails
